svg.text: Layout Thread — Stage 8 — Display List Fragment Construction
Pass 4 (P4): Final Fragment Assembly — Replaced Content → Display List
P4 = SVG rasterized image available | Also handles Image, Video, IFrame, Canvas
P1: svg_kind_size() queues serialization, returns None vector_image → no Fragment
P2: serialize_and_cache_subtree() creates data: URL → P3: cache lookup → P4: raster available
P4: make_fragments() gets vector_image → rasterizes → Fragment::Image → Display List
All SVG_TRACE_STAGE_8 eprintln! calls originate from this function
